items.title: What Does Fiserv (FISV) Gain From Its New Merchant Services Partnership?
items.summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) announced a new global partnership with Mastercard to integrate advanced merchant services into Mastercard Merchant Cloud.
